problem: Acute sanitation deficiencies in Indian urban areas, including lack of infrastructure and inadequate wastewater management systems
solution: Implementation of multi-tiered initiatives by LPU and partner institutions: academic courses for students, specialized workshops for community-based wastewater treatment, city sanitation planning (e.g., Dalhousie), and capacity-building programs for professionals
technology: Decentralized sanitation systems, faecal sludge and septage management (FSSM), hybrid sanitation approaches, community-based wastewater treatment, anaerobic digestion, and constructed wetlands
outcome: Development of sustainable sanitation education frameworks, city-level sanitation plans for pilot cities, and enhanced technical capacity for professionals and students in non-networked sanitation solutions
